title: Ing Pamanyubuk ning Pau
intro: Ing metung a komunidad, na magnasang manimuna para idipensa ing karelang sangkan, migpetisyon ya para keng metung a kumander para miyalal karela. Inyang mekibat ya ing karelang anyaran, ing mepili metung yang pamagduda, uling ing indibidwal a ini ala yang katayuan a makayatu a inasa ra. Bayu ing katataulian a pamakipaglaban, ining bayung lider subukan ne ing disiplina ning army kapamilatan ning simple, pero malalam, a pamagsubuk king pamagpigil.
clues: Mepili kung pekapun kaybat deng memalen ku mekisabi lang lider para lumaban para keng Allah.
Dakal kareng sarili kung tau ing minunang mengutang keng kanakung appointment, uling ala kung pibandian ampo noble a linya.
Mepili ku uling dininan naku ning Allah dakal a beluan ampo masikan a katawan.
Metung a malino tanda ning cacung divinung pangatalaga ya pin ing pamagbalik na ning Kaban ning Tipan, a darala da ring angeles, a migdalang kapayapan karing pusu da ring talasalpantaya.
Kabang magmartsa ku kayabe da ring sundalus ku, pepabalu ku king subukan da kami lele ning metung a ilug.
Inutus ku karing sundalus ku king ing ninumang minum malalam king ilug e ya kayabe ku, kabang manatili la detang metung mung kutsara king gamat da.

identity.label: Ninu Aku?
options: Jalut (Goliath)
Talut (Saul)
Propeta Dawud
Dhul-Qarnayn
Namrud (Nimrod)

trial.label: Nanu ing peka-panyubuk ku?
options: Gagawa yang salang laban kang Gog ampo Magog
arapan me ing higante keng metung a laban
Pamanyubuk king kapamintuan ning metung a hukbu king metung a ilug
manimuna ya keng army da reng jinn ampo ayup
makaligtas ya keng miyugse keng api
trial.answer: Pamanyubuk king kapamintuan ning metung a hukbu king metung a ilug

location.label: Nanu ing metung a tanda ning kakung awtoridad?
options: Metung a tukud a meging ubingan
Metung a kamelyu a linual king batu
Metung a coat ning mail a gawa keng melambut a bakal
Ing Kaban ning Tipan (At-Tabut)
Metung a lamesa ning pamangan ibat banua

outcome.label: Nanu ing meging bunga ning kakung kampanya?
options: Pamagtagumpe kareng sundalus nang Jalut (Goliath)
Pamikawani keng Dayat Malat a Mapula para makatakas keng tiranu
Mitatag kung makabang dinastiya keng lagyu ku
Pamangawang sagradung Kaaba keng Makkah
Mitas ya banua a alang kamatayan

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
